blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .
blocks.zh: 视频时间定位旨在将自然语言查询视频中的事件本地化. 对于围绕冷冻的视频语言模型构建的物剂来说,这种牵引力决定了询问如何指导时间预测以及如何完善这些预测. 手动精炼这些带子需要诊断落地故障,并协调对代理工作流程和指令的修改. 我们引入了VideoEvolve, 这个框架会自动演化代理设备 用于视频时间定位。 视频 Evolve使用Cloze-Structured Harness代表器,它保留了舞台界面,同时让代理工作流程和指令对进化开放. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution保留了有希望的代码分支供继续完善,使用执行反馈指导本地编辑和验证以确定哪些改进被推进. 实验表明,跨越多个基准的基础业绩有所改善。 组成部分分析将改进指示确定为一致的收益来源,而不断发展的守则的好处则因评价环境而异。 这些成果共同支持自动利用演化,作为改进视频时间定位的有效方法。 代码见https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video temporal grounding localizes the interval in a video that matches a natural-language query, connecting video understanding to temporally grounded retrieval and reasoning. Identifying the right event and its boundaries can remain difficult when similar actions recur or a query specifies relations between events ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) . For example, the same action may be clearly recognizable at several points in a video, while its position before or after another event determines which occurrence matches the query. An agent may need to inspect additional evidence, revisit an initial prediction, or resolve competing interval hypotheses. How these decisions are organized affects the path from interpreting video content to selecting a temporal interval. For agents built around video-language models, this process depends on both the model and the execution procedure surrounding it.
blocks.zh: 视频时间定位将时间间隔定位在符合自然语言查询的视频中,将视频理解与基于时间的检索和推理联系起来. 如果发生类似事件,或查询具体说明事件之间的关系,则很难确定正确的事件及其界限(Zhang等人,2026c; 张等,2026d). 例如,同一动作可能在视频的几个点上可以清楚地识别,而它在另一事件之前或之后的位置则决定了哪个事件与查询吻合. 代理人可能需要检查其他证据,重新审视初步预测,或解决相互竞争的间隔假设。 如何组织这些决定会影响从解释视频内容到选择时间间隔的路径. 对于围绕视频语言模型构建的代理商来说,这一过程既取决于模型,也取决于其周围的执行程序.

blocks.en: Recent work improves temporal grounding through instruction tuning ( Ren et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) , reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and self-evolving model training ( Jung et al., 2026 ) . Alongside these advances in model learning, agentic approaches organize query decomposition, grounding, verification, and adaptive reasoning into executable workflows ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) . The workflows and instructions surrounding a model form its harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Improving a grounding harness requires coordinating how instructions describe an event with how code obtains and combines predictions. For example, a revised rule for distinguishing repeated events may call for changes to when a prediction is checked or which alternative interval is selected. Manually making such changes requires diagnosing failures and translating them into reusable procedures. A correction for one ambiguous query may change behavior elsewhere, so successful predictions also need to inform how the harness is revised. This motivates automatically improving the harness while keeping the target video-language model frozen.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作通过指导调试(Ren等人,2024年;Huang等人,2024年),强化学习(Wang等人,2025a年),以及自演模式培训(Jung等人,2026年),改善了时间定位. 除了在模式学习方面的这些进步外,代理方法还将查询分解、定位、核查和适应性推理组织成可执行的工作流程(郑等人,2024年;刘等人,2026年;张等人,2026年d). 围绕一个模型的工作流程和指示形成了它的牵引力(Lee等人,2026年;张等人,2026年a). 改进地面控制装置需要协调指示如何描述一个事件以及如何获得和结合预测的代码。 例如,关于区分重复事件的订正规则可能要求修改检查预测时或选择何种替代间隔。 人工进行这种修改需要诊断失败并将其转化为可重复使用的程序。 对一个模棱两可的查询进行更正可能会改变其他地方的行为,因此成功的预测也需要告知如何修改这一带子. 这在保持目标视频语言模型冷冻的同时,可以自动地改善牵引力.

blocks.en: Program-based agent design already offers a foundation for this approach: ADAS and Meta-Harness search over executable agent programs ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , while the Darwin Gödel Machine retains historical programs as starting points for further improvement ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . We organize harness evolution for temporal grounding around two requirements. First, changes to hypothesis generation must remain compatible with downstream verification and selection. The representation should therefore preserve the interfaces that carry observations, interval hypotheses, and verification evidence, while leaving internal workflows and instructions open to revision. Second, an intermediate code change may require further edits before the complete harness is ready for adoption. Search should allow such programs to continue developing, while using evaluation of the complete candidate to decide which changes are inherited. A local edit must be assessed in the context of the full harness, since its effect can depend on existing instructions and downstream decision rules. Together, these requirements connect an editable grounding representation with a search procedure that separates continued exploration from acceptance.
blocks.zh: 基于程序的代理设计已经为这种方法提供了基础:ADAS和Meta-Harness对可执行代理程序的搜索(Hu等人,2025年;Lee等人,2026年),而达尔文·格德尔机器保留了历史程序作为进一步改进的起点(Zhang等人,2026年b). 我们围绕两项要求来组织时间演变。 首先,假设生成的改变必须与下游核查和选择保持一致。 因此,代表应保留载有观测、间隔假设和核查证据的接口,同时留有内部工作流程和指示可供修改。 第二,中间代码的修改可能需要在完整的控制器准备通过之前进行进一步编辑。 搜索应允许这类程序继续开发,同时利用对完整候选人的评价来决定哪些变化被继承. 本地编辑必须结合充分利用情况进行评估,因为其影响取决于现有指示和下游决定规则。 这些要求将可编辑的地面代表与将继续探索与接受分开的搜索程序联系起来。

blocks.en: We introduce VideoEvolve , a framework that evolves grounding harnesses using labeled development feedback while keeping the target model frozen (Figure 2 ). Its Cloze-Structured Harness Representation preserves stage interfaces while allowing executable workflows and instructions within them to evolve. Execution traces, grounding errors, and successful predictions from the current harness provide evidence about which decisions should be revised and which behavior should be preserved. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution uses execution feedback to guide local edits, preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, and validates complete candidates before adopting them as the basis for subsequent iterations. We evaluate the resulting harnesses on five grounding benchmarks. Figure 1 illustrates the approach and its gain over the initial harness. VideoEvolve exceeds the compared frozen-model workflows on Charades-STA and ActivityNet, and matched comparisons show gains over its seed on all five benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while code contributions vary across benchmarks. This distinction motivates evaluating both grounding quality and inference usage when assessing an evolved harness.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了VideoEvolve(VideoEvolve), 这个框架利用标注的开发反馈, 来演化地盘, 它的Cloze-Structured Harness Disposition保留了舞台界面,同时允许其内部可执行的工作流程和指令演化. 执行痕迹、确定错误和从当前手段中得出的成功预测提供了证据,说明哪些决定应当修订,哪些行为应当保留。 分支-Guided Harness Evolution使用执行反馈来指导本地编辑,保留有希望的代码分支以继续完善,并验证完整的候选人,然后才采用它们作为后续重复的基础. 我们根据五个基准来评估由此产生的办法。 图1说明了这一方法及其在初始利用方面的收益。 视频 演进量超过了Charades-STA和ActiveNet上比较的冷冻模型工作流程,匹配的比较显示,在所有五个基准中,其种子都有增益。 组成部分分析将改进指导确定为一致的收益来源,而代码贡献因基准而异。 这种区分促使人们在评估进化的绳索时评价其基础质量和推论用途。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce VideoEvolve and a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that supports evolving grounding workflows and instructions within stable stage interfaces around a frozen video-language model. • We develop Branch-Guided Harness Evolution, connecting feedback-guided local edits and continued code-branch refinement with validation-based inheritance of complete harnesses. Development feedback guides branch retention, while validation determines which complete candidates are accepted and inherited by subsequent iterations. • We evaluate the evolved harnesses on five grounding benchmarks, using search controls, code–instruction exchanges, and deployment-cost measurements to characterize performance, component contributions, and inference cost.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了VideoEvolve和Cloze-Structured Harness代表系统,支持围绕冷冻视频语言模型在稳定的舞台界面中不断演变的地面工作流程和指令。 我们开发了分公司指导的“合理性演进”,将反馈指导的本地编辑和继续改进编码部门与基于验证的完整“合理性”继承联系起来。 发展反馈指导分支保留,而验证则决定哪些完整的候选人被后续迭代接受和继承. ^ 我们利用搜索控制、代码-指令交换、部署成本衡量等五个基准来评估不断发展的利用情况,以描述性能、成份贡献和推论成本。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Temporal Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.1 录像时间定位

blocks.en: Feature-based grounding methods learn temporal predictions from video–text representations. MH-DETR ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and UVCOM ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) improve cross-modal interaction and temporal modeling for moment retrieval and highlight detection. Video-language models extend this line through architectures and training procedures that connect visual content to timestamps. TimeChat ( Ren et al., 2024 ) introduces time-aware encoding and instruction tuning, VTimeLLM ( Huang et al., 2024 ) develops boundary-aware training, and LLaVA-MR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) combines frame and time encoding with generative moment prediction. Time-R1 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) investigate reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for temporal localization. More recently, EvoGround ( Jung et al., 2026 ) constructs training signals from raw videos through a self-reinforcing proposer–solver loop that updates both models. These approaches improve learned grounding components through task-specific training. VideoEvolve uses labeled development feedback to optimize a reusable harness around a frozen video-language model, directing improvement toward its executable workflow and instructions.
blocks.zh: 基于地物的地基方法从视频文本表述中学习时间预测. MH-DETR(Xu等人,2024年)和UVCOM(Xiao等人,2024年)改进了跨模式的交互和时间模型,用于瞬间检索和突出检测. 视频语言模型通过将视觉内容与时间戳连接起来的架构和培训程序来扩展这条线路. 时间 Chat(Ren等人,2024年)引入了时间意识编码和指令调制,VTimeLLM(Huang等人,2024年)开发了边界意识训练,LLaVA-MR(Lu等人,2026年)结合了帧和时间编码与基因瞬间预测. Time-R1(Wang等人,2025a)和TimeLens(Zhang等人,2026c)调查强化学习,对时间本地化给予可核查的奖励. 最近,EvoGround(Jung等人,2026年)通过一个自我强化的求婚者-Solver循环,从原始视频中构建培训信号,更新两种模式。 这些办法通过针对具体任务的培训,改进了学习到的基本内容。 视频 Evolution使用标签化的开发反馈,在冷冻的视频语言模型周围优化可重复使用的套路,引导改进转向其可执行的工作流程和指令.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理视频理解

blocks.en: Agentic and workflow-based methods organize video evidence into intermediate decisions before producing a prediction. For temporal grounding, TFVTG ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) decomposes queries into sub-events and combines their localization results using temporal relations, while ChatVTG ( Qu et al., 2024 ) combines clip captioning, query matching, and moment refinement. DART ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) adapts the reasoning route to query difficulty. Beyond these grounding workflows, VideoTree ( Wang et al., 2025b ) expands a query-relevant hierarchy of visual evidence, and VideoMind ( Liu et al., 2026 ) coordinates planning, grounding, verification, and answering through role-specific LoRA adapters. These approaches illustrate how evidence selection, additional observations, and prediction refinement can be organized within an agent. Their procedures can adapt to individual videos and queries; VideoEvolve additionally treats the programs implementing such decisions as objects of development-time search. Execution feedback guides changes that persist in the harness used for subsequent grounding tasks.
blocks.zh: 基于代理和工作流程的方法在作出预测之前将视频证据组织到中间决定中。 对于时间定位,TFVTG(郑等人,2024年)利用时间关系将查询分解为子事件,并结合其本地化结果,而ChatVTG(Qu等人,2024年)则结合了剪辑字幕,查询匹配,以及瞬间完善. DART (Zhang et al., 2026d) 调整推理路径以适应查询难度. 除了这些地面工作流程外,VideoTree(Wang et al.,2025b)扩展了与查询相关的视觉证据层级,VideoMind(Liu et al.,2026)通过特定角色的LORA适配器来协调规划,地面,校验和回答. 这些方法说明如何在代理人内部组织证据选择、额外观察和预测改进。 他们的程序可以适应个人的视频和询问; VideoEvve 将执行此类决定的程序作为开发时搜索的对象. 执行反馈指导了在用于随后的地面作业的利用方面持续存在的变化。

blocks.en: 2.3 Automated Agent Design and Harness Evolution
blocks.zh: 2.3 自动代理设计和利用

blocks.en: Automated agent design broadens optimization from model inputs to the systems that construct and act on them. ADAS ( Hu et al., 2025 ) represents agent designs in code, allowing search over executable workflows. Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) optimizes task-specific harness programs using prior source code, scores, and execution traces. Self-Harness ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) uses the evaluated model itself to diagnose weaknesses and propose bounded harness edits, which are then evaluated through regression tests. VideoEvolve follows this program-based view and structures the editable space around the information exchanged during video grounding. Its Cloze-Structured Harness Representation preserves stage interfaces while allowing internal workflows and instructions to evolve. This structure maintains the passage of observations, interval hypotheses, and verification evidence as their processing rules change; an external coding agent proposes the modifications.
blocks.zh: 自动代理设计将优化范围从模型输入扩大到构建和操作它们的系统。 ADAS(Hu et al.,2025)代表代码中的代理设计,允许搜索可执行的工作流程. 梅塔- 哈内斯 (Lee et al., 2026) 利用先前的源代码,分数,以及执行的痕迹,优化任务专用的牵引程序. Self-Harness (Zhang et al., 2026a) 利用被评价的模型本身来诊断弱点,并提出捆绑的绳索编辑,然后通过回归测试来评价. 视频 演进沿袭这个基于程序的视图和结构,围绕视频地面时交换的信息进行编辑. 其Cloze-Structured Harness Disation保留了舞台界面,同时允许内部工作流程和指令进化. 这种结构随着处理规则的改变而维持了观测、间隔假设和核查证据的通过;一个外部编码代理提出修改。

blocks.en: Search history provides alternative starting points for further improvement. The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) maintains an archive of agents whose code can be modified, including intermediate designs that serve as stepping stones. AutoHarness ( Lou et al., 2026 ) organizes code hypotheses in a tree and selects nodes for feedback-guided refinement. Meta-Harness retains evaluated programs and allows its proposer to inspect prior artifacts without imposing a parent-selection rule. VideoEvolve’s Branch-Guided Harness Evolution organizes exploration around a current champion and a retained code branch, allowing further edits to a program that has not yet replaced the champion. Validation determines whether a complete candidate is adopted and inherited by subsequent iterations. This separates continued exploration from acceptance within the stage-structured grounding harness.
blocks.zh: 搜索历史为进一步改进提供了其他起点。 达尔文·格德尔机器(DGM)(Zhang et al., 2026b)维护着一个可以修改代码的代理的档案,包括作为踏脚石的中间设计. AutoHarness(Lou et al., 2026)在树上组织代码假说,并选择节点进行反馈引导的改进. Meta-Harness保留了被评价的程序,并允许其提议者在不强制规定家长选择规则的情况下检查以前的文物. 视频 Evolve的分支- Guided Harness Evolution 围绕当前冠军和保留代码分支组织探索,允许进一步编辑一个尚未取代冠军的程序. 验证决定一个完整的候选人是否通过并继承以后的迭代. 这使继续探索与在分阶段结构的地面架上接受分离。

blocks.en: 3 VideoEvolve
blocks.zh: 3 视频 演变

blocks.en: A video grounding harness coordinates how a model interprets a query, revisits visual evidence, and resolves competing interval predictions. VideoEvolve improves this procedure by evolving the harness around a frozen video-language model. Its Cloze-Structured Harness Representation preserves the interfaces through which grounding stages exchange information, while leaving their workflows and instructions editable. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution uses execution feedback to refine candidate programs, retaining intermediate code branches for further exploration. Validation determines which complete harness is inherited by subsequent iterations. Figure 2 illustrates the framework.
blocks.zh: 一个视频地面吊带协调一个模型如何解释一个查询,重温视觉证据,并解决相互竞争的间隔预测. 视频 通过围绕一个冷冻的视频语言模型,不断改进这一程序。 其Cloze-Structured Harness Discription保留了地面阶段交换信息的界面,同时将其工作流程和指令留待编辑. 分支-Guided Harness Evolution利用执行反馈来完善候选程序,保留中间代码分支以进一步探索. 验证决定了哪个完全的吊带由之后的迭代继承. 图2说明了该框架。

blocks.en: Figure 2: VideoEvolve. (a) Fixed stage interfaces contain editable workflows, with instructions evolving alongside code. (b) Retained code branches are refined off the accepted-harness mainline. Development comparison and validation gate promotion, while eligible validation rejections provide a repair path.
blocks.zh: 图2:视频演变。 (a) 固定阶段接口包含可编辑的工作流程,指令与代码一起演变。 (b) 保留代码分支从接受的热线中提炼出来。 开发比较和验证门推广,而符合条件的验证拒绝提供修补路径.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task and Harness Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务和优势优化

Let ℋ B \mathcal{H}_{B} contain executable harnesses that satisfy the stage interfaces and per-instance resource limits B B . blocks.en: 3.2 Cloze-Structured Harness Representation

A change to how interval hypotheses are generated must remain compatible with how later stages verify and select them. We therefore separate a stable execution skeleton from editable stage implementations and instructions. The representation is cloze-structured : designated parts of a working harness can be rewritten while the interfaces connecting them remain fixed. The editable contents are executable code and text, allowing search to introduce new decision rules within this structure.
blocks.zh: 改变间隔假设是如何生成的,必须与以后阶段如何验证和选择这些假设保持一致。 因此,我们将一个稳定的执行骨架与可编辑阶段的执行和指示分开。 表示式为块状结构 :工作带的指定部分可以在连接它们的接口保持固定时重写. 可编辑的内容是可执行的代码和文本,允许搜索在此结构内引入新的决定规则.

blocks.en: The six stages in Figure 2 organize observation, hypothesis generation, cross-checking, arbitration, additional resource use, and finalization. Shared state carries visual observations, candidate intervals, verification evidence, and the current selection between stages. Within each stage, code can revise model interactions, tool use, and hypothesis processing; instructions can revise event matching and boundary judgments. Fixed stage order thus supports flexible internal workflows. For example, the budget_gate stage can obtain another prediction and revise the selected interval before finalization, allowing refinement to occur within the existing interfaces.
blocks.zh: 图2的六个阶段组织观察、假设生成、交叉核对、仲裁、额外资源使用和定稿。 共享状态包含视觉观察,候选间隔,核查证据,以及目前各个阶段之间的选择. 在每个阶段,代码可以修改模型交互,工具使用和假说处理;指令可以修改事件匹配和边界判断. 因此,固定的阶段顺序支持灵活的内部工作流程。 例如,预算_gate阶段可以在定稿前获得另一个预测并修改选定的间隔,从而在现有接口内进行完善。

blocks.en: Each proposal modifies one permitted code or text surface and inherits the rest of its parent harness. Candidates must pass interface checks before evaluation as complete executable harnesses. Successive inherited edits can therefore combine changes to code and instructions across iterations, while each proposal targets a local modification.
blocks.zh: 每项提案修改一个允许的代码或文本表面,并继承其母机的其余部分。 候选人必须在评价前通过接口检查,作为完整的可执行工具。 因此,相继继承的编辑可以将代码和指令的修改合并到整个迭代中,而每个提案都针对一个局部修改.

blocks.en: 3.3 Branch-Guided Harness Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.3 部门指导的优势演变

blocks.en: An intermediate code change may need further revision before the complete harness is suitable for adoption. VideoEvolve therefore maintains two roles: the champion contains accepted improvements and supplies the current execution evidence, while a retained code branch provides an alternative parent for continued refinement. A branch can accumulate edits before it qualifies to replace the champion.
blocks.zh: 中间代码的修改可能需要进一步修订,然后才能采用完整的控制。 视频 因此,Evolution维持着两个角色:冠军包含被接受的改进,并提供了当前执行证据,而保留下来的代码分支则为继续完善提供了一个替代的母公司. 分支可以在有资格替换冠军之前累积编辑.

blocks.en: At iteration t t , executing the champion h t h_{t} on the current development batch produces predictions, execution traces, and ground-truth-based evaluations. We assemble these into evidence E t E_{t} , including failures and a weakness summary to guide revision, successful cases to preserve, and feedback from earlier attempts. An external coding agent uses this evidence and the permitted edit surface to propose candidate j j : h t , j = Edit ⁡ ( p t , j , E t ) , h_{t,j}=\operatorname{Edit}(p_{t,j},E_{t}), (2) where p t , j p_{t,j} is the parent being edited. The current evidence describes the champion’s behavior even when the edit starts from a different parent.
blocks.zh: 在迭代 t t, 执行当前开发批次的冠军 h t h_{t] 产生预测, 执行痕迹, 以及基于地面真相的评价. 我们把这些汇编成证据E t E_{t}, 包括失败和弱点摘要, 外部编码代理使用此证据和允许编辑的表面,提出候选 j : h t, j = 编辑 ⁡ (p t, j, E t ), h_{t, j}=\operatorname{Edit}(p_{t, j}, E_{t }), (2) 在p t, j p_{t, j} 被编辑的父文本 。 目前的证据描述了冠军的行为,即使编辑是从不同的家长开始的.

blocks.en: Ordinary proposals start from h t h_{t} . Code proposals can instead extend the retained code attempt with the highest recorded development score among those evaluated under the current champion. Retention makes an unaccepted program available for another edit; it does not change the active champion. The branch resets after a promotion or when its retry allowance is exhausted, anchoring subsequent exploration to the current accepted harness.
blocks.zh: 普通建议从h t h_{t}开始。 相反,守则建议可以扩大保留守则的尝试范围,在目前冠军下评价的人中以最高的发展成果记录。 保留使得一个未被接受的程序可供另一个编辑使用;它不会改变活动冠军. 分公司在晋升后或复试津贴用完后,将随后的探索定位在目前接受的绳索上。

blocks.en: Validation rejections provide targeted repair feedback. A candidate that improves the development score but fails validation can become a near miss . Eligible near misses receive a bounded repair opportunity: the proposal starts from the champion, or the retained branch for code edits, and uses the rejected candidate’s changes together with aggregate regression diagnostics to guide the edit. Branch retention uses development scores, while repair responds to a specific validation rejection. Both mechanisms generate candidates for the same selection procedure.
blocks.zh: 验证拒绝提供有针对性的修复反馈. 提高发展分数但验证失败的候选人, 符合资格的近失获得一个有限度的修复机会:提议从冠军开始,或者从保留分支开始代码编辑,并使用被拒绝的候选人的修改和汇总回归诊断来指导编辑工作. 分支保留使用开发分数,而修复则对特定的验证拒绝做出回应. 这两个机制都为同一甄选程序产生候选人。

blocks.en: 3.4 Validation-Guided Harness Selection
blocks.zh: 3.4 验证 - 指导性优势选择

blocks.en: Selection determines which exploratory changes become the next accepted harness. Because development batches vary across iterations, each valid candidate is compared with the champion on the same batch. Only the highest-scoring candidate that strictly improves on the champion proceeds to validation; otherwise, the champion is retained and code attempts remain eligible for branch continuation.
blocks.zh: 选择决定哪些探索性变化成为下一个被接受的带. 由于开发批次在不同的迭代中各有不同,因此每个有效候选人在同一个批次上与冠军进行对比. 只有得分最高且能严格提高冠军的候选者才能进入验证阶段;否则,冠军被保留,代码尝试仍然有资格继续分支.

blocks.en: The candidate and champion are then compared on a validation batch separated from the development batch by video. Acceptance requires grounding performance to remain within the permitted regression limits and execution to satisfy resource and reliability constraints. A fixed reference harness also anchors the quality check. Rejection preserves the champion and provides aggregate diagnostics for possible repair. Per-example validation content is withheld from the proposer, but its aggregate feedback can influence later edits; validation is therefore part of search, separate from the final endpoint evaluation.
blocks.zh: 然后通过视频将候选人和冠军与开发批次分开的验证批次进行比较。 接受要求业绩必须保持在允许的回归限度内,执行必须满足资源和可靠性方面的限制。 固定的参照带还支撑着质量检查。 拒绝保留了冠军,并为可能的修复提供了综合诊断. 逐例验证内容不向提议者透露,但其汇总反馈会影响以后的编辑;因此验证是搜索的一部分,与最终终点评价分开.

blocks.en: At most one complete candidate replaces the champion in each iteration. Subsequent proposals inherit its evaluated combination of code and instructions. Search returns the last champion, which is deployed with the frozen model and tools. Algorithm 1 summarizes the loop.
blocks.zh: 最多一个完整的候选人在每个迭代中取代冠军. 随后的提案继承了其经过评价的代码和指令的组合. 搜索返回最后一个冠军,它与冻结的模型和工具一起部署. 算法1总结了循环.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate grounding performance, disentangle code and instruction contributions, and examine the search and inference costs of the resulting harnesses. We then connect retained edits to observed execution behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们评价基本性能、分散代码和教学贡献,并审查由此而来的利用的搜索和推断费用。 然后,我们将保留的编辑与观察到的执行行为连接起来。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on five benchmarks: Charades-STA (test), ActivityNet (val_2), QVHighlights (validation), ReXTime (validation), and TimeLens-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . ActivityNet includes 17,016 evaluated queries after excluding five videos with inconsistent decoded durations; ReXTime includes all 921 validation queries. TimeLens-Bench contains 9,404 queries across Charades-TimeLens, ActivityNet-TimeLens, and QVHighlights-TimeLens. We use the queries and temporal annotations released by Zhang et al., who refined these datasets through manual annotation and cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个基准:Charades-STA(测试)、活动网(val_2)、QV高清(验证)、ReXTime(验证)和TimeLens-Bench(Zhang等人,2026c)。 活动 Net包括17,016个评价的询问,不包括5个解码持续时间不一致的视频;ReXTime包括所有921个验证询问. TimeLens-Bench包含9,404个贯穿Charades-TimeLens,活动网-TimeLens,以及QVHighlights-TimeLens的查询. 我们使用张等人发布的询问和时间说明,张等人通过手动注释和交叉验证来完善这些数据集.

blocks.en: We report mean temporal IoU (mIoU) and recall at IoU thresholds 0.5 and 0.7 (R@.5 and R@.7), expressed as percentages. On the original QVHighlights split, predictions are scored by their maximum IoU over all annotated windows. Following the TimeLens-Bench evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , we report recall and mIoU; we aggregate each metric equally over its three datasets. For search and component analyses, we summarize the grounding metrics as S = 0.5 ​ mIoU + 0.3 ​ R ​ @ ​ .5 + 0.2 ​ R ​ @ ​ .7 S=0.5\,\mathrm{mIoU}+0.3\,\mathrm{R@.5}+0.2\,\mathrm{R@.7} , averaged equally across the three datasets. Failed TimeLens queries receive zero IoU and remain in the denominator; on the original benchmarks, valid fallback intervals are scored and invalid intervals receive zero IoU.
blocks.zh: 我们报告指的是时间性IoU(mIoU),并按IoU阈值0.5和0.7(R@5和R@7)。 在最初的QVHighlights拆分上,预测在所有附加注释的窗口上以最大IoU打分. 在TimeLens-Bench评估(Zhang等人,2026c)之后,我们报告召回和mIoU;我们按其三个数据集平均汇总每个计量。 关于搜索和组件分析,我们总结了地面测量标准,即S=0.5 mIoU + 0.3 R@5.+0.2 R@7. S=0.5\,\mathrm{ mIoU}+0.3\,\mathrm{R@.5}+0.2\,\mathrm{R@7},平均横跨三个数据集. 失败的TimeLens查询收到0 IoU,并留在分母中;在原始基准上,有效的倒置间隔被打分,无效间隔则收到0 IoU.

blocks.en: Unless otherwise stated, our harness experiments use frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (Qwen-35B). Additional experiments use gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. A coding agent using gpt-5.6-sol proposes harness edits. Each search allocates 60 proposal slots over 20 rounds, subject to per-query limits of four solver calls and 96 observed frames.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,我们的拉带实验使用冷冻的Quen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8(Quen-35B). 额外的实验使用gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. 一个使用 gpt-5.6-sol 的编码代理提议了 hab 编辑 。 每次搜索在20轮内分配60个提议槽,但以4个解调器调用和96个观察到的帧为每轮限制.

blocks.en: Published training-based methods and frozen-model workflows provide task-level references under their reported settings. Controlled comparisons hold the target model fixed: we compare the evolved harness with its exact Cloze seed and exchange seed and evolved components. These evaluations use frozen endpoints without further optimization. A separate Full/No-Branch search pair tests branch retention while preserving champion inheritance, historical feedback, validation, and repair.
blocks.zh: 公布的基于培训的方法和冷冻模型工作流程提供了报告环境下的任务级参考。 受控比较使目标模型固定下来:我们比较进化的牵引力与其精确的克洛兹种子和交换种子以及进化的组件. 这些评价使用冻结的终点,而没有进一步优化。 一个单独的Full/No-Branch搜索对子测试分支保留,同时保留冠军继承权,历史反馈,验证,以及修复.

blocks.en: Each search comparison uses one completed run per arm; the reported results compare the resulting frozen endpoints.
blocks.zh: 每次搜索比较均采用每臂一次完成的运行;报告结果比较了由此产生的冻结终点。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results on Video Temporal Grounding
blocks.zh: 4.2 录像时间定位的主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Video temporal grounding results on five benchmarks, comparing VideoEvolve with training-based and agentic methods. R@.5 and mIoU are reported as percentages; higher is better. Bold indicates the best result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表1:视频时间依据五个基准得出的结果,比较视频 采用基于培训和代理方法。 R@5和mIoU报告为百分比;较高情况较好。 粗体表示每栏的最佳结果.

blocks.en: Table 1 places VideoEvolve in the broader grounding landscape. VideoEvolve surpasses the listed frozen-model workflows on Charades-STA and ActivityNet and compares favorably with the listed training-based methods across the reported benchmarks, although MH-DETR retains higher ActivityNet recall. It also exceeds the published Time-R1 reference on both TimeLens macro metrics. Strong performance in both recall and mIoU indicates that the evolved harness improves not only the frequency of predictions above the overlap threshold but also average temporal alignment. Together, these results show that harness design offers a practical route to stronger temporal grounding without parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 表 1 位视频 演化在更广泛的地面景观中. 视频 发展超越了Charades-STA和ActiveNet上列出的冻结模式工作流程,与所有报告基准上列出的培训方法相比是有利的,尽管MH-DETR保留了更高的ActiveNet召回量。 它也超过了两个TimeLens宏度量法上公布的Time-R1参考. 强有力的召回和mIoU的性能表明,进化的牵引力不仅提高了超过重叠阈值的预测频率,而且提高了平均时间吻合度. 这些结果表明,利用设计为在没有参数更新的情况下加强时间定位提供了一个切实可行的途径。

blocks.en: Matched seed-to-evolved comparisons provide direct evidence for improvement within the same model. Relative to the exact Cloze seed, VideoEvolve improves mIoU on all five benchmarks. The gains on Charades-STA and QVHighlights extend beyond videos used for harness development and selection. Because the solver is unchanged in these comparisons, the improvements are attributable to the evolved harness as a whole, including its instructions and inference procedure. The following analyses examine branch retention, the resulting harness components, and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 匹配的种子与演化的比较为同一模型内的改进提供了直接证据。 相对于确切的克洛兹种子,VideoEvolve在所有五个基准上都改进了mIoU. Charades-STA和QVHighlights上的收益超越了用于驾驭开发和选择的视频. 由于这些比较中的解码器没有变化,这些改进可归因于整个演化的拉带,包括其指令和推论程序. 以下分析研究了分支保留、产生的利用组件和计算成本。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: A separate Full/No-Branch search pair tests whether continuing promising non-champion branches helps harness discovery. Both arms start from the same seed and use the same development sampling schedule and 60 proposal slots. No-Branch removes branch continuation while retaining champion inheritance, historical feedback, validation, and repair. As Table 2 shows, branch retention improves mIoU on Charades-STA and QVHighlights and increases TimeLens macro S S by 1.58 points. ReXTime also improves, while ActivityNet mIoU is slightly lower. The gains on the two video-disjoint benchmarks support keeping alternatives available beyond the current champion. Full also uses fewer development-time solver calls than No-Branch, so the advantage in this pair does not come from greater solver usage.
blocks.zh: 单独的Full/No-Branch搜索配对测试持续有希望的非champion分支是否有助于利用发现. 两种武器都从同一个种子开始,并使用同样的开发取样时间表和60个提议档。 No-Branch在保留冠军继承权,历史反馈,验证,以及修复的同时,移除分支续作. 如表2所示,分支保留在Charades-STA和QVHighlights上改进mIoU,并将TimeLens宏SS增加1.58分. ReXTime 也有所改进, 而活动 净mIoU略低. 在两个视频-联合基准上取得的成果有助于将替代品保留在目前的冠军之外。 Full还使用比No-Branch更少的开发时解调器调用,因此此对中的优势并不来自更大的解调器使用.

blocks.en: Table 2: Branch-retention ablation; endpoints come from a separate search pair.
blocks.zh: 表2: 分支保留衰减;端点来自单独的搜索对.

blocks.en: No-Branch still receives historical feedback and can revise the champion, so its lower performance on most benchmarks suggests that remembering previous outcomes does not fully replace the ability to continue editing a retained program.
blocks.zh: No-Branch仍然收到历史反馈,可以修改冠军,因此其在大多数基准上的较低表现表明,记住以前的结果并不能完全取代继续编辑保留程序的能力.

blocks.en: Table 3: Grounding quality and per-query inference cost of harness components. TimeLens-Bench quality is macro-averaged.
blocks.zh: 表3:牵引部件的地面质量和每水推论成本。 TimeLens-Bench的质量为宏观平均.

blocks.en: We exchange seed and evolved code and instructions while keeping the target model fixed, without further optimization. Instructions comprise the grounding prompt and textual skills. On ReXTime and TimeLens-Bench, replacing either seed component with its evolved counterpart improves recall and mIoU, and the full harness achieves the highest values of both metrics (Table 3 ). Restoring either component to its seed version lowers the full harness’s performance, showing that both evolved components contribute in these evaluations. Their effects differ across settings: the conditional mIoU gain from evolved code is larger on ReXTime than on TimeLens-Bench. These results connect improvements in query interpretation with changes to prediction refinement, with the strongest evaluated configuration retaining both evolved components.
blocks.zh: 我们交换种子和进化的代码和指示,同时保持目标模型的固定,而不进一步优化. 教学包括即时和文字技能。 在ReXTime和TimeLens-Bench上,用其进化的对应物取代任一种子成分改进了召回和mIoU,而充分利用则实现两个度量的最高值(表3)。 恢复种子版本的任一组成部分都降低了充分利用的性能,表明这两个演化成的组成部分都有助于这些评价。 其效果因设置不同而不同:在ReXTime上,从进化代码中有条件的mIoU收益大于在TimeLens-Bench上. 这些结果将查询解释的改进与预测改进的改变联系起来,最强评价的配置保留了两个演化的组件。

blocks.en: 4.4 Search and Inference Cost
blocks.zh: 4.4 搜索和推断费用

blocks.en: The seed-to-evolved improvements in Table 3 result from a search using 60 proposal slots and 217,767 solver calls. Search cost measures the computation used to discover the harness; deployment cost measures its per-query inference usage. The search budget includes repeated candidate evaluations that are incurred during development. Once an endpoint is selected, subsequent queries execute that fixed harness without invoking the coding agent or repeating candidate selection. This separates the upfront cost of discovering a reusable procedure from the cost paid each time it is applied.
blocks.zh: 表3的种子至演化改进是利用60个提案档和217 767个解题电话进行搜索的结果。 搜索成本衡量用于发现牵引装置的计算;部署成本衡量其每水推算的使用情况。 搜索预算包括开发期间反复进行的候选评价。 一旦选定了终点,随后的查询将执行固定的套接字,而不引用编码代理或重复候选人的选择. 这把发现可重复使用的程序的预付费用与每次使用时支付的费用分开。

blocks.en: Table 3 also reports deployment usage. The full harness uses more calls and input tokens than the seed and instruction-only configurations on both benchmarks, while all four configurations retain the same 64 sampled frames. Its additional computation therefore revisits existing observations. Average usage varies across benchmarks, reflecting the conditional refinement policy; the quality gains come with increased inference cost. Instructions alone improve quality without adding solver calls, although their longer text increases input-token usage. The full harness uses slightly fewer calls than the code-only configuration on both benchmarks, yet consumes more input tokens. Call counts and token volume therefore capture different aspects of deployment cost: the former reflects how often predictions are revisited, while the latter also accounts for the instructions supplied on each call.
blocks.zh: 表3还报告了部署使用情况。 完全套用比两个基准上的种子和仅指令配置更多的调用和输入符,而所有四个配置都保留相同的64个抽样帧. 因此,它的额外计算重新审视了现有的意见。 平均使用率因基准而异,反映了有条件的完善政策;质量收益随着推论成本的增加而增加。 单是指令可以提高质量,而不增加解答者调用,尽管其较长的文本会增加输入式调用. 在两个基准上,全吊带使用的调用略少于只使用代码的配置,然而消耗更多的输入符. 因此,呼叫计数和信使数量反映了部署费用的不同方面:前者反映的是重复预测的次数,后者还说明每次呼叫时提供的指示。

blocks.en: 4.5 Evolved Harness Behaviors
blocks.zh: 4.5 演化的策略行为

blocks.en: The seed grounding instruction asks for the segment that best matches the question. The evolved instruction adds explicit occurrence and boundary tests: “Sweep the full timeline in chronological order and form a candidate interval for every plausible occurrence, rather than committing to the first or most salient partial match.” It also requires that “immediately before the start the first required action or state must not yet hold, and immediately after the end the last required action or state must no longer hold.” These retained instructions specify how to distinguish repeated events and check temporal boundaries.
blocks.zh: 种子搁浅指示要求最符合问题的部分. 进化指令增加了明显的发生和边界测试: “按时间顺序整理全部时间表,为每一次可能发生的事件形成一个候选人间隔,而不是承诺进行第一次或最突出的部分匹配。” 它还要求“在开始之前立即采取所要求的第一项行动或国家必须尚未采取,在结束之后立即采取所要求的最后行动或国家必须不再采取”。 这些保留的指示具体规定了如何区分重复的事件并检查时间界限.

blocks.en: The seed harness returns one grounding prediction from 64 uniformly sampled frames. The evolved harness keeps these observations but changes how predictions are obtained and combined: it requests another whole-video hypothesis when the timeline is coarsely sampled or the predicted interval occupies an unusually small or large fraction of the video. Substantial disagreement can trigger a third call, after which start and end coordinates are combined by their medians. Evolution thus changes both when to revisit a prediction and how to reconcile alternatives.
blocks.zh: 种子牵引装置从64个统一取样的帧中返回一个地面预测。 演化的拉带保留了这些观测,但改变了预测的获得和结合方式:当时间线被粗细地取样或预测间隔占据了视频的异常小或大部分时,它要求另一种全视频假说. 重大分歧可能引发第三次呼叫,之后的始末坐标由它们的中位数合并. 因此,演变既改变了何时重新审视预测,也改变了如何调和替代办法。

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares the seed, instruction-only, and full configurations on two queries. For the kettle query, the seed and instruction-only predictions precede the annotated event. The full harness executes two calls and returns the annotated interval, [33,36] s. In this example, replacing instructions alone does not recover the event, whereas the complete evolved procedure does. The recorded execution follows the two-hypothesis median path.
blocks.zh: 图3比较了种子,仅指令,以及两个查询的完整配置. 对于壶式查询,种子和仅指令的预测在注释事件之前. 全吊带执行两个呼叫并返回注释间隔,[33,36] s. 在这个例子中,仅取代指示并不能恢复事件,而完整的演化程序才是。 所记录的处决遵循了双伪中位路径.

blocks.en: For the light-switch query, the seed correctly predicts [0,1] s, but the instruction-only configuration shifts the interval to [1,3] s. The full harness uses three calls and returns [1,4] s, still missing the annotated event. This regression illustrates a limitation of combining model-generated hypotheses: combining additional predictions does not guarantee correct temporal alignment. Together, these cases illustrate why the aggregate benefit of executable refinement can depend on the evaluation setting: additional hypotheses can recover a missed event, but they can also preserve or amplify a localization error.
blocks.zh: 对于轻开关查询,种子正确预测[0,1] s,但仅指令配置将间隔转移到[1,3] s. 全吊带使用3个呼叫并返回 [1,4] s,仍然缺少附加说明的事件. 这种回归表明结合模型产生的假设是有局限性的:合并额外的预测并不能保证正确的时间吻合. 这些案例加在一起说明了为什么可执行性改进的总体好处可以取决于评价设置:额外的假设可以恢复一个错失的事件,但它们也可以保存或放大一个本地化错误.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Grounding refinement and failure. Final predictions from the seed ( C 0 ​ T 0 C_{0}T_{0} ), evolved instructions alone ( C 0 ​ T 1 C_{0}T_{1} ), and full harness ( C 1 ​ T 1 C_{1}T_{1} ). Shading marks the ground-truth interval; calls count solver invocations.
blocks.zh: 图3:基础完善和失败。 种子的最终预测(C0 T 0 C_{0} T_{0}), 进化指令单(C0 T 1 C_{0} T_{1}), 和全利用(C1 T 1 C_{1} T_{1}). 沙丁标志着地面-真相间隔; 呼叫计数解析器引用.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented VideoEvolve for automatically evolving video temporal grounding harnesses around frozen models. Cloze-Structured Harness Representation preserves stage interfaces while exposing workflows and instructions to revision; Branch-Guided Harness Evolution combines feedback-guided edits, continued branch exploration, and validation-based inheritance. Experiments show gains over initial harnesses across multiple benchmarks, with component analyses revealing context-dependent contributions from code and instructions. These results support harness evolution as a practical route to stronger grounding without parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了VideoEvolve,用于围绕冷冻模型自动演化的视频时间定位装置。 Cloze-Structured Harness Dependence在披露工作流程和修改指令的同时,保留了阶段界面; Branch-Guided Harness Evolution结合了反馈引导编辑,持续分支探索,以及基于验证的继承. 实验显示,在跨越多个基准的初始利用基础上,取得了收益,组成部分分析显示代码和指令对具体情况的贡献。 这些成果支持利用进化,作为在没有参数更新的情况下加强地面的实用途径。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used a language-model-driven coding agent to generate and modify the executable code and task instructions of video temporal grounding agents, and used generative AI tools to assist with code editing, figure and table preparation, and reviewing the manuscript for clarity of expression. The authors reviewed the AI-assisted content and take responsibility for the final manuscript, code, and scientific claims.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们使用语言模型驱动的编码代理生成和修改视频时空定位代理的可执行代码和任务指令,并使用基因AI工具协助代码编辑,图和表的制备,审查手稿以清晰表达. 提交人审查了AI协助的内容,并对最后的手稿、代码和科学主张负责。
